title: Perceptual statistics for every Transformers palette — tf_palette_stats
text: names Palette names compute . Defaults palettes.

title: Perceptual statistics for every Transformers palette — tf_palette_stats
text: data frame one row per palette columns: palette Palette name. n_colours Number colors. min_de Smallest pairwise Lab distance two colors. Larger easier tell apart; 20 comfortable floor categorical use. min_de_deutan, min_de_protan, min_de_tritan simulating color-vision deficiency. lum_range Range CIE lightness (0 100) across palette. hue_spread Angular spread chromatic colors' hues, degrees. Near 0 means one hue family. hue_clusters Number distinct hue families (hues separated 60 degrees). has_light Whether palette contains light neutral color can serve midpoint. categorical, colorblind, sequential, diverging Logical flags used tf_find_palettes().

title: Perceptual statistics for every Transformers palette — tf_palette_stats
text: Distances CIE76 (Euclidean CIE Lab). Color-vision deficiency simulated Machado, Oliveira Fernandes (2009) matrices full severity deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia. Hue statistics consider colors chroma least 20, greys blacks count hue.
